title: We had an amazing tour...
text: We had an amazing tour with Pau.  We learned so much about the city, the culture, and food.  His passion for the city allowed us to get a true understanding of how its history remains alive in the modern era. We really appreciated Pau tailoring the to us. We mostly walked but also utilized the great transit system to reach more areas. We had one of the best meals with him at a fantastic restaurant. We highly recommend Pau.
author: Julia_K

title: Best guide in the city
text: We had a fantastic tour with Allan. He was punctual, extremely well prepared, and clearly experienced with families—he knew how to keep our small children engaged so we could still see all the highlights of Barcelona. When our son unexpectedly needed a doctor, Allan handled everything swiftly and professionally, smoothing out the situation within minutes and keeping us calm. He is caring, efficient, and focused on giving clients the best possible experience. If you’re visiting with kids or want someone who plans thoughtfully and acts quickly in an emergency, Allan comes highly recommended.
author: Irina_O

title: Gaudi and more!
text: This was a fantastic private tour with Alfredo! Alfredo and City Unscripted were great in getting in touch before the tour to see what my interests were and what I wanted to do, and working with me to plan the day. I really wanted to visit several Gaudi sites in Barcelona, and Alfredo was very open with working with that plan. He also gave me a heads up in advance about the weather forecast (rain) and we adjusted our plan for the day. There was excellent communication before and during the tour. Alfredo was great in allowing me to explore different transportation options available in the city
author: Siobhan_M

title: Excellent private walking tour
text: Excellent walking tour! City unscripted is terrific. It was my 2nd time using them and Federico my tour guide was fabulous
author: David_R

title: Wonderful tour with Frederico
text: Our guide, Frederico, made this a wonderful day for us.  We had only the afternoon and evening to see the city, and Frederico made the most of it.  He met us at our hotel, which we appreciated.  We saw the beauty of the city, easily rode the train to get to a couple of spots, and had plenty of time to ask questions, take photos and learn about the city.  Frederico's love of Barcelona is evident and contagious.  We had dinner in great spot for tapas and walked through all the sites we wanted to see, including a wonderful local market and a 360 view of the city from the top of a hotel.  Frederic
author: Stephanie_R

title: Fantastic tour!
text: My tour guide Jonathan was outstanding! He was warm, friendly and very knowledgeable about Barcelona. I learned a lot about the city and more importantly gained a new friend! 😀
author: Cathleen_O

title: Educational, informative and FUN!
text: Our guide, Ivanna was the best! She contacted me before the tour to find out what things we were interested in. She organized a custom tour for us. As we started the tour, we began to ask questions and decided to modify the tour. She was right on top of this and didn't miss a beat even with the changes that we wanted while keeping it fun! She is also very knowledgeable and informative. We very highly recommend this tour with Ivanna!!
author: James_D

title: Brilliant tour by Johnathan
text:
We had an 8 hours walking tour with Jonathan. From our initial meet and greet moment, he was very welcoming. It definitely felt like a stroll through Barcelona key attractions and areas with a friend. The best thing about it was we walked without any rigid plan and we could spend as long as we wanted at any given venue. 

Jonathan was frank enough to say he didn’t know answers to all of the questions cos principally he is a “host” not a professional 9-5 tour guide! We really appreciated this.
